notes.title: 🚀 Pro DLC Coming Soon – Support Development & Unlock Exclusive Extras!
notes.notes: [p]The [b]Pro DLC[/b] is almost here! 🎉[/p][p]This add-on is for players who want to support the ongoing development of [b]Meco Rocket Simulator[/b] and get access to behind-the-scenes extras.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s inside:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🎵 [b]Original Soundtrack[/b] – high-quality MP3 music files[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]PDF Technical Papers & Notes[/b] – dive into the science behind Meco’s simulation engine[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]3D-Print Files[/b] – showcase turbopump geometry from our prototype code (great for educational or desk models)[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Hi-Res “Miku” Wallpapers[/b] – the game’s mascot/guide in stunning detail[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]🧡 [b]Early Supporters Bonus:[/b][/p][p]Everyone who bought [b]Meco[/b] before this change automatically gets the [b]Pro DLC free[/b]. Thank you for backing us early![/p][p][/p][p]💡 [b]Why a Pro DLC?[/b][/p][p]Many players asked for a cheaper base price. This keeps [b]Meco Rocket Simulator[/b] accessible, while giving fans a way to support development and unlock behind-the-scenes goodies.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Note: You must own [b]Meco Rocket Simulator[/b] to use this content.[/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the beginning — the Pro DLC is still in Early Access! Future updates (included for free) will bring:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Exportable 3D-print files of Turbopump, Nozzle & Injector parts[/p][/*][*][p]Scriptable Custom Components[/p][/*][*][p]Scriptable Custom UI[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced Fluid Network Solvers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]👉 The Pro DLC launches soon — add it to your wishlist and get ready to support [b]Meco Rocket Simulator[/b] in the next stage of its journey![/p]

notes.title: Get HUGE Discounts by Being an Early Bird
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.mecorocketsimulator.com/kickstarter-early-bird/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=annoucement&utm_campaign=kickstarter_early_bird][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166508/52ee2b52756e7c1b2432c4605f24157ccf2b15d3.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Why Kickstarter?[/h1]
Meco has been self-funded until now and is pending an Early Access launch on Steam. It took three years of intense work to get to this stage, where I am confident that the product works well. 

Along the way, I lost sight in both eyes due to a rare genetic condition and had a heart attack which was odd because I am not obese and am only 45. Thankfully after a bunch of surgical interventions, my sight is mainly restored, and the doctors say that my ticker should serve me for another decade or more.

I aim to serve the most people in the shortest time, and I want to focus on my health simultaneously.  Funds raised with Kickstarter will be employed to delegate administrative, marketing, game design, community engagement, project management, and game documentation, including making videos and tutorials for the community.
